sources.source: Bulletin: BDUK Delivery Performance, annual: April 2025 to March 2026
sources.role: Annual subsidy-delivery statistics are aggregate programme outputs and cannot establish current serviceability or measured speed for a selected parcel without an exact premises-level join.

sources.source: Quality and Methodology Information for BDUK Delivery Performance, annual: April 2025 to March 2026
sources.role: The QMI explains methods, estimates, source systems and limitations; it is not itself a current parcel-coverage dataset.

sources.source: Bulletin: BDUK delivery performance, quarterly: October 2025 to Dec 2025
sources.role: Quarterly official statistics report aggregate subsidy-attributable delivery and revised time series, not current selected-parcel orderability or measured speed.

sources.source: Bulletin: BDUK delivery performance, quarterly: April 2025 to Sept 2025
sources.role: The release contains aggregate, revisable official statistics and geographic summaries; it cannot be transferred to selected parcels without an exact current join.

sources.source: Bulletin: BDUK delivery performance, quarterly: April 2024 to December 2024
sources.role: This first historical quarterly release reports revised aggregate subsidy delivery and source versions; it cannot establish current selected-parcel coverage.

sources.source: Local Full Fibre Network programme evaluation plan
sources.role: An evaluation framework and programme theory cannot establish current serviceability or measured speed for selected parcels.

sources.source: Local Full Fibre Networks Programme wave one final evaluation
sources.role: Pilot-project evaluation findings and counterfactual analyses are historical programme evidence, not current selected-parcel availability.

sources.source: Superfast Broadband Programme Evaluation: Key Benefits and Impacts
sources.role: Historical evaluation of programme benefits, productivity and value for money cannot verify current orderability or measured speed for selected parcels.

sources.source: BDUK Rural Gigabit Connectivity Hubs Evaluation
sources.role: Evaluation evidence around connected public buildings and nearby outcomes cannot establish current selected-parcel serviceability or measured speed.
Crowdsourced mobile-device observations describe mobile experience in sampled coverage areas and cannot establish fixed-broadband parcel coverage or measured fixed speed.
Affordability research describes household experience, survey responses and social-tariff awareness; it is not physical network availability or parcel performance evidence.

sources.source: Report: Complaints about broadband, landline, mobile and pay-TV services
sources.role: Complaint rates measure customer dissatisfaction relative to provider subscriber bases and cannot establish coverage, orderability or parcel-measured speed.

sources.source: Latest telecoms and pay-TV complaints revealed - Q4 2025
sources.role: Provider-level complaint findings are service-quality indicators and cannot verify physical availability or parcel-specific network performance.
The Communications Market portal contains aggregate market, industry and consumer-research data, not exact current selected-parcel coverage or measured speed.
Operator deployment plans are forward-looking and confidence-qualified; they cannot be treated as current selected-parcel serviceability or measured speed.
